_comment: FRANK v2 Governor operating point. These are the breaker NUMBERS (the shape is fixed in tools/autonomy/governor.mjs and docs/frank-v2-architecture.md Part 9 item 1). Start conservative; loosen as the spend-ledger earns trust. All 'invocations' are model-call units: a governed-run of --max=10 counts as 10 against these caps, so the 2026-06-09 scale (hundreds of concurrent max-effort spawns) is unreachable.

failure_rate._comment: Halt a lane when it is mostly failing. The 2026-06-09 audit-drain re-burned 154 rows that failed ~every cycle; that pushes a lane's recent failure rate far above 0.35. Steady-state defect noise (~16% on 2026-06-09) stays below it, so healthy operation is not halted.

anthropic._comment: Daily TOKEN ceiling is the dollar backstop; the binding runaway guards are the invocation caps + failure-rate breaker above. ~75k tokens/call is the observed manual-fetch claude --print cost; 3M/day ~= 40 calls before the budget binds.

codex._comment: Codex is free on the ChatGPT Plus sub (no API billing). No token budget, but invocations still count against the per-run/hour/day caps and the failure-rate breaker.
